underlines.text: that what nose he has—his spout hole
depresses his head altogether beneath the surface

reference.text: Moreover you observe that the whale has no external nose; and that what nose he has—his spout hole—is on the top of his head; you observe that his eyes and ears are at the sides of his head, nearly one third of his entire length from the front.
In some previous place I have described to you how the blubber wraps the body of the whale, as the rind wraps an orange.
